svg.title: The write-test without its second tick
svg.desc: With the tick after the restore deleted, the copy's test starts while the copy still holds the real angle's probe, so the copy passes too. A table of the write-test's six steps on seed 1 after one RIGHT press, with what the real angle, a float at 65840, and the status line's copy, an integer at 71968, hold after each. 1: write the probe 53 into the real angle; real 53, copy 46. 2: tick 2 frames: the copy is rebuilt from the real angle; read back 53: held; real 53, copy 53. 3: restore the real angle to 46 with no tick after it; real 46, copy 53. 4: the copy reads 53, so its probe is 46: write 46 into it; real 46, copy 46. 5: tick 2 frames: the copy is rebuilt from the real angle; read back 46: held; real 46, copy 46. 6: restore the copy to 53 with no tick after it; real 46, copy 53. Afterwards the status line still reads ANGLE 46.
svg.text: The real angle: f32 at 65840; the copy: i32 at 71968
2. tick 2 frames: the copy is rebuilt
from the real angle; read back 53: held
4. the copy reads 53, so its probe
5. tick 2 frames: the copy is rebuilt
from the real angle; read back 46: held
afterwards the status line still reads ANGLE 46
